items.question: For each portfolio, show the total value of Technology sector holdings and what percentage it represents of the total portfolio value
items.sql: WITH part AS (SELECT h.portfolio_id, SUM(h.quantity * s.current_price) AS tech_value FROM holdings h JOIN securities s ON s.security_id = h.security_id JOIN sectors sec ON sec.sector_id = s.sector_id WHERE sec.sector_name = 'Technology' GROUP BY h.portfolio_id), whole AS (SELECT h.portfolio_id, SUM(h.quantity * s.current_price) AS total_value FROM holdings h JOIN securities s ON s.security_id = h.security_id GROUP BY h.portfolio_id) SELECT p.portfolio_name, part.tech_value, whole.total_value, ROUND(part.tech_value * 100.0 / whole.total_value, 2) AS tech_percentage FROM part JOIN whole ON whole.portfolio_id = part.portfolio_id JOIN portfolios p ON p.portfolio_id = part.portfolio_id ORDER BY tech_percentage DESC
items.message: Returns the portfolio name, Technology sector market value, total portfolio market value, and percentage share of Technology holdings for portfolios containing Technology stocks, sorted by percentage descending.
items.explanation: The executed result matches the reference result exactly.

history.sql: WITH part AS (SELECT h.portfolio_id, SUM(h.quantity * s.current_price) AS tech_value FROM holdings h JOIN securities s ON s.security_id = h.security_id JOIN sectors sec ON sec.sector_id = s.sector_id WHERE sec.sector_name = 'Technology' GROUP BY h.portfolio_id), whole AS (SELECT h.portfolio_id, SUM(h.quantity * s.current_price) AS total_value FROM holdings h JOIN securities s ON s.security_id = h.security_id GROUP BY h.portfolio_id) SELECT p.portfolio_name, part.tech_value, whole.total_value, ROUND(part.tech_value * 100.0 / whole.total_value, 2) AS tech_percentage FROM part JOIN whole ON whole.portfolio_id = part.portfolio_id JOIN portfolios p ON p.portfolio_id = part.portfolio_id ORDER BY tech_percentage DESC

items.question: Find portfolios that have holdings in more than 5 different sectors and show their diversification metrics
items.sql: SELECT p.portfolio_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.sector_id) AS distinct_sectors, COUNT(h.holding_id) AS total_holdings, 1.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT s.sector_id) / COUNT(h.holding_id) AS diversification_ratio FROM portfolios p JOIN holdings h ON p.portfolio_id = h.portfolio_id JOIN securities s ON s.security_id = h.security_id GROUP BY p.portfolio_id, p.portfolio_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.sector_id) > 5 ORDER BY diversification_ratio DESC
items.message: Returns portfolios with holdings spanning more than 5 distinct sectors along with their sector count, total holdings count, and diversification ratio.
items.explanation: The executed result matches the reference result exactly.
